# Example of a FHIR Document

This page provides an example of an EKG Recording Bundle to illustrate a practical example of how a FHIR Document Bundle can be profiled. <br>

*Note: The narrative texts (text.div) elements in the examples are autogenerated. They are not representative of the MedCom Governance demands for narratives and must only be treated as incomplete example representations. Find [MedCom Governance for narratives here](https://medcomdk.github.io/MedComLandingPage/assets/documents/GeneralGovernanceFHIRStandards.html#5-implementation-requirements-for-narrative-texts).* <br>

The example includes a FHIR EKG Recording Document Bundle with the following resources included: Composition, an Observation containing the actual EKG recording as base64 content, a Patient, and the sending organization, PractitionerRole and Practitioner.
The example also includes a clinical note in the Observation resource.

Find the [example here](Bundle-0a74554f-ded3-4bc7-bef1-535699565c5b.html) in both JSON and XML.
